entries.ae0d550ee2f30ed5: Based on its corporate creed of “Trust,” it has set a 10-year long-term management plan, the “OCEAN+2 Strategy,” and since April 2024 has been advancing the “Second Medium-Term Management Plan: Establishing a Foundation” (fiscal years ended March 2025 to March 2027). It positions the “Arkh Concept,” based on its in-house original “Arkh series” products born from advanced crystal growth and processing technology, as its most important management strategy, and is advancing full-scale mass production of the Arkh series, expansion of its product lineup, and industry standardization through supplying built-in crystal resonators to competitors.
entries.b37953f08ee118e5: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 2.4% year on year to ¥39,551 million. The analysis of operating results explains that, while demand declined in the communications and consumer fields due to the impact of a sharp rise in memory semiconductor prices, the automotive field remained firm and the industrial field shifted to a gradual recovery trend. It is also noted that the company focused on strengthening production capacity for crystal oscillators and high-frequency products, and on expanding sales of the Arkh series.

It is noted that the crystal device market is expected to grow further due to expanding demand from digitalization, while in the crystal industry, competition has intensified with the rise of overseas manufacturers, such as those in China and Taiwan, in addition to competition with Japanese companies.
